span.p: Supply objectives, intended tone, recent events, local factions, committed activities, pending developments, public presentation records, and evidence of deadlines communicated to the player

div.style: color: rgb(23, 40, 72) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;
div.span: 1. Review pending threads first. What needs introduction, continuation, or no change? Distinguish committed developments from tentative proposals.

div.style: color: rgb(77, 57, 15) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: A deadline is due AND was communicated to the player?

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: Honor only the communicated deadline; retain consequences needing introduction. Hidden schedules remain gated. Do not release a backlog of discretionary escalations.

div.style: color: rgb(23, 40, 72) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;
div.span: 2. For each thread, does its latest material development have sufficient public context? Identify a natural introduction opportunity, or let it wait.

div.style: color: rgb(23, 40, 72) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;
div.span: 3. Which factions meaningfully intersect current player objectives? Cite established activity, or answer none. An independently acting member alone does not count.

div.style: color: rgb(23, 40, 72) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;
div.span: 4. Describe current roles: ally, orthogonal, friendly rival, bitter rival, negotiable opposition, pure evil, patron, gatekeeper, or another specific role. Roles may overlap by objective.

div.style: color: rgb(23, 40, 72) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;
div.span: 5. Relative to the story's intended tone, pressures, choices, and pacing, would support, opposition, both, or neither help now? Account for pending involvement.

div.style: color: rgb(77, 57, 15) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
color: rgb(23, 62, 39) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: Save assessment and any introduction opportunities; retain existing developments

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: Seek usable help: ally, patron, refuge, supplier, intelligence, or shared interests. Preserve losses and player choice.

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: Seek meaningful conflict: competition, demands, obstruction, rivalry, or an implacable threat. Preserve earned victories.

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: Seek complementary support and opposition with distinct interests; avoid duplicating pending developments

div.style: color: rgb(23, 40, 72) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;
div.span: 6. Which existing factions have a plausible stake, means, and local presence for these roles? Identify any unmet roles.

div.style: color: rgb(77, 57, 15) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
color: rgb(23, 40, 72) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;
div.span: 8. Plan the next future activity: what, where, through whom, and when or under what conditions? Describe attempts and how the player could encounter them.

div.style: color: rgb(23, 40, 72) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;
div.span: 7. Generate only for unmet roles: identity, goals, methods, resources, local presence, and possibility of accommodation. Pure evil is valid.

div.style: color: rgb(77, 57, 15) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: Would this advance a thread whose latest material development is still unintroduced?

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: Hold the next discretionary development. Prioritize a plausible introduction of the existing one; no automatic catch-up.

div.style: color: rgb(23, 40, 72) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;
div.span: 9. Check continuity and agency: future activity only; no invented past faction involvement, rewritten causes, forced player choices, or guaranteed outcomes. Revise proposals as needed.

div.style: color: rgb(23, 40, 72) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;
div.span: 10. Synthesize only proposed new factions and a short list of faction plans: specific objectives, current next steps, and awareness constraints. Keep worksheet reasoning internal.

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: Validate proposal against settled current state: identities, references, duplicate commitments, and allowed transitions

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: Return exact feedback to the relevant checkpoint; retry within its budget

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: Revise the rejected checkpoint only, preserving accepted facts and avoiding duplicate commits

div.style: color: rgb(23, 62, 39) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: Persist approved faction changes, assessments, and eligible future activities. Retain held threads without advancing them.

div.style: color: rgb(23, 62, 39) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: After application, resolve new faction references and insert the compact faction plans and next steps into base context to guide current faction behavior

div.style: color: rgb(23, 62, 39) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: A material development becomes a committed fact

div.style: color: rgb(23, 62, 39) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: Await meaningful public context; pause further discretionary escalation of this thread

div.style: color: rgb(77, 57, 15) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;
color: rgb(23, 62, 39) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: Present a rumor, message, witness, encounter, or consequence that supplies context. Causes may remain mysterious.

div.style: color: rgb(77, 57, 15) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
color: rgb(23, 62, 39) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: Record passage reference and what it established. No acknowledgment, quest acceptance, or comprehension score required.

div.style: color: rgb(23, 62, 39) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: The thread is eligible for a later discretionary development, when appropriate
